title: Identification of the finite source quotient
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of the l-adic rationals, a scheme T, Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern] and a finite level n, the evaluated integerGenerator followed by the evaluated and forgotten scalarGenerator and the comparison finiteScalarForgetIso [def-sfb-finite-forget-comparison] equals finiteQuotient [def-sp-tower-class-finite].

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension and finite evaluation

proof.text: Apply the integerGenerator section equation to a constant integer k. The Forget morphism equation identifies its scalarGenerator image with the coefficient ring map applied to k. Ring maps preserve integer casts.

The section equation of finiteScalarForgetIso transports the forgotten image to that actual finite section. Thus the candidate satisfies the defining section equation of finiteQuotient. Apply uniqueness.

theorem finiteBoundary_sourceMap (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T) (n : ℕ) :
    (abEvaluation T n).map (integerGenerator T (Rrings l T) c.reduction.forget) ≫
      (c.reduction.forget.F ⋙ abEvaluation T n).map (scalarGenerator l E T) ≫
      (finiteScalarForgetIso l E c n).hom.app (coefficient T (Arings l E T)) =
      finiteQuotient l E T n
